The '''A99 custom biome generator''' was a model of biome generator produced by [[Tri-Planetary Atmospheric]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It recreated any biological environment in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] or [[Space station/Legends|space stations]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />
